Title: Kithul Treacle
Body (HTML):
Kithul sap, cooked down over a wood fire until it is thick and dark. The only ingredient is the sap.

Pour it over curd or hoppers, stir it into tea, or bake with it in place of golden syrup.

Title: Kithul Jaggery
Body (HTML):
Kithul treacle cooked further until it sets, then cut into cubes. Eat a piece with a cup of tea, or grate it into desserts.

250 g.

Title: Kithul Flour
Body (HTML):
Flour from the pith of the kithul palm, dried and milled. Use it to make porridge, or to thicken sauces and desserts.

250 g.
